name: @arp/hook
description: A runtime PostToolUse hook: records what a session invoked, as the runtime sees it, to .arp/session.jsonl.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun build src/hook.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'arp-[name].js' --target=bun --external viem --external 'viem/*' --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun'
